camel_example: aliyun hbr DescribeVaults --region cn-hangzhou --Status CREATED --Tag.1.Key key1 --VaultType STANDARD --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-000000000000000000000' --PageNumber 1 --VaultName vaultname --Tag.1.Value value1 --Replication true --VaultOwnerId 144000000732 --VaultId 'v-000000000000000000000' --VaultRegionId 'cn-shanghai'
description_en: Describes one or more backup vaults that meet specified criteria
description_zh: 获取一个或者多个符合条件的备份仓库信息
kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-vaults --vault-id v-000000000000000000000 --vault-region-id cn-shanghai --status CREATED --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --vault-type STANDARD --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --resource-group-id rg-000000000000000000000 --vault-name vaultname --vault-owner-id 144000000732 --replication true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVaults

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the backup vault resides
parameters.name: vault_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the backup vault.

UNKNOWN: The status is unknown.

INITIALIZING: The backup vault is being initialized.

CREATED: The backup vault has been created.

ERROR: An error occurred
parameters.help_zh:
备份仓库状态。

UNKNOWN：未知
INITIALIZING：初始化中
CREATED：已创建
ERROR：错误
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the backup vault. Valid values:

STANDARD: standard backup vault. This type of vault can be used for ECS file backup, OSS backup, and NAS backup.

OTS_BACKUP: Tablestore backup vault. This type of vault is dedicated to Tablestore backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份仓库类型。取值
STANDARD：表示普通仓库，可用于ECS文件备份、OSS备份、NAS备份等。
OTS_BACKUP：表示TableStore仓库，仅可用于TableStore备份，且TableStore需要使用该类型的仓库
parameters.name: vault_type

parameters.help_en: The tags. You can specify a maximum of 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签信息。最大支持20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the backup vault. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 备份仓库名称。长度为1~64个字符
parameters.name: vault_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_owner_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query the backup vaults that are used as replication destinations
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询复制目标备份库
parameters.name: replication
